subject: Initial phone screen — Kiera O'Keefe availability
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Kiera O'Keefe <kiera.ok@example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Initial phone screen — quick availability?

Hi Kiera,

Thanks for applying to the Software Engineer, Inference position and for taking the time to chat. I'm Priya on the recruiting team at Redwood Inference — would love to schedule a quick 30-minute phone screen so we can learn more about your background and share next steps.

A few windows that work on our side (all PDT):
- Wed 30 Sep — 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Thu 1 Oct — 09:00–11:00

If none of those work, please share 2–3 slots that do and your timezone. Also: can you attach the most recent resume you'd like us to use for the interview?

I attached a short recruiter prep doc with what to expect.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | (415) 555-0126

Attachments: recruiter_prep_20260928.pdf (3 pages)
From: Kiera O'Keefe <kiera.ok@example.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.narajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 11:30:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Initial phone screen — quick availability?

Hi Priya,

Thanks — I'm currently in Eastern Daylight Time (EDT). I can do Wed 30 Sep between 14:00–16:00 EDT (that lines up with your 11:00–13:00 PDT window) or Thu 1 Oct between 09:30–10:30 EDT. I prefer mornings EDT but can be flexible on Wednesday.

30 minutes is perfect. I attached my resume here.

Best,
Kiera O'Keefe
kiera.ok@example.com | +1 (617) 555-9842

Hi Kiera — great, thanks for the quick reply and for sending your resume.

Let's lock in Wednesday, 30 Sep at 14:00 EDT / 11:00 PDT for a 30-minute phone screen with Jonas (hiring manager). I just sent a calendar invite with a Google Meet link — please accept if the time works. Meeting details are in the invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite-id 

If you'd prefer a phone call instead of Meet, reply with the best number to reach you and we'll switch it.

> On Tue, Sep 28, 2026 at 11:30 AM EDT, Kiera O'Keefe <kiera.ok@example.com> wrote:
